[EN] [Pond Faire—Daily] Slay the Dragons
[ES] [Feria de la charca - Diaria] Mata a los dragones
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Not exactly equitable work there."
[ES] "Ese no es un trabajo exactamente equitativo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt bubu dragons and collect their meat.
[ES] Caza dragones bubu y recolecta su carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Just call me dragonslayer."
[ES] "Llámame matadragones."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to the bonfire, skewer and cook the meat.
[ES] Regresa a la hoguera, ensarta y cocina la carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the dragon on a stick to Haroso.
[ES] Lleva el dragón en brocheta a Haroso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
